title: PermissionRuleReach
description: What a rule's pattern reaches, structured by the domain over the canonical grammar (`describeReach`) — what a screen writes its sentence from, never the client reinterpreting the pattern (plan 03, D-12; plan 15, B-02).

engine.description: The engine the reach is bounded to, or absent/`null` when the rule's `kind` reaches every engine that has it.

kind.description: The canonical kind, repeated here so the reach is self-contained.

form.description: `any` — the whole kind, no matcher; `exact` — the literal matcher; `prefix` — a `:*` or glob prefix, bounded at a token or path-segment edge.

content.description: The matcher's own text (the command, the path glob, the domain, the MCP server/tool) — `null` on `form: any`.

excludesCompound.description: `true` when an `allow` prefix in `shell` does not cover a command carrying a shell operator (plan 15, D-07) — the one case where the reach says less than the prefix reads.
